topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I got home a bit later than usual today, and the first thing I noticed was that my driveway was empty. It took a moment, but then I saw the note on the front door. My car had been towed. It was strange, considering it was in my own driveway. I took a deep breath and decided to handle it systematically. I called the number on the note, got the details of where my car was, and the process to get it back. It’s going to cost a bit, but it’s a fixable problem. I’ll head over there tomorrow after work to sort it out.
